titulo: Study of Pembrolizumab (MK-3475) Plus Chemotherapy vs Placebo Plus Chemotherapy as Neoadjuvant Therapy and Pembrolizumab vs Placebo as Adjuvant Therapy in Participants With Triple Negative Breast Cancer (TNBC) (MK-3475-522/KEYNOTE-522)

braco.texto: Participants receive 200 mg pembrolizumab every 3 weeks (Q3W) + 80 mg/m\^2 paclitaxel weekly + carboplatin (Area Under the Curve \[AUC\]1.5 weekly or AUC5 Q3W) x 4 cycles, followed by 200 mg pembrolizumab Q3W + (60 mg/m\^2 doxorubicin OR 90 mg/m\^2 epirubicin) + 600 mg/m\^2 cyclophosphamide Q3W x 4 cycles as neoadjuvant therapy prior to surgery; followed by 9 cycles of 200 mg pembrolizumab Q3W as adjuvant therapy pos
braco.textoPt: Os participantes recebem 200 mg de pembrolizumabe a cada 3 semanas (Q3W) + 80 mg/m\^2 paclitaxel semanalmente + carboplatina (Área sob a curva \[AUC\]1,5 semanalmente ou AUC5 Q3W) x 4 ciclos, seguido por 200 mg de pembrolizumabe Q3W + (60 mg/m\^2 doxorrubicina OU 90 mg/m\^2 epirrubicina) + 600 mg/m\^2 ciclofosfamida Q3W x 4 ciclos como terapia neoadjuvante antes da cirurgia; seguido por 9 ciclos de 200 mg de pembrolizumabe Q3W como terapia adjuvante pos

trechos: followed by 9 cycles of 200 mg pembrolizumab Q3W as adjuvant therapy post-surgery.
trechosPt: seguido por 9 ciclos de 200 mg de pembrolizumabe Q3W como terapia adjuvante pós-cirurgia.

braco.texto: Participants received adjuvant or neoadjuvant chemotherapy with pegfilgrastim prophylaxis in addition to prophylactic naproxen 500 mg orally twice a day (BID) for 5 days in each of the 4 cycles, beginning on the day of pegfilgrastim administration.

titulo: Rituximab and Combination Chemotherapy in Treating Older Patients With Previously Untreated B-Cell Lymphoma

braco.texto: Arm II (pharmacokinetic-based dose-dense rituximab): Patients receive rituximab IV 375 mg/m\^2 (females) and 500 mg/m\^2 (males) over 4 hours on days -1, 0, 3, 7, 14, 21, 28, and 42. Patients also receive pegfilgrastim subcutaneously on day 4 of each course.
braco.textoPt: Braço II (rituximabe de dose densa com base em farmacocinética): os pacientes recebem rituximabe IV 375 mg/m\^2 (mulheres) e 500 mg/m\^2 (homens) durante 4 horas nos dias -1, 0, 3, 7, 14, 21, 28 e 42. Os pacientes também recebem pegfilgrastim por via subcutânea no dia 4 de cada curso.
